summary: test(functional-tests): cover passkey passwordless Sync sign-in end to end
description:
Because:

* Passwordless Sync had no browser-level coverage of opting in and then
  signing in without the password

This commit:

* Adds an E2E that opts in after the password fallback, then signs in to
  Sync passwordless in a second browser
* Lets the passkey polyfill reuse credentials minted in another browser
* Exports newPagesForSync for tests that need a second Sync browser
* Adds unit tests for promo order and the login-before-opt-in hand-off

Fixes FXA-13154
